scope: project-owned procedural paving response and construction-semantic edge-wear/dirt transfer across unrelated historic and contemporary hosts
acceptedSystemEvidence: the paving compiler normalizes X/Z loops to outward winding; top and inset-band normals face upward, bevel and side normals face outward, and bottom normals face downward
historic and contemporary paving carry five typed vertex attributes: signed value, roughness and weathering plus bounded edge-wear and dirt-accumulation masks
each visible unit top contains an explicit inset construction band that interpolates joint-adjacent dirt and edge exposure into a cleaner interior instead of placing dirt only on hidden sides
surface-level construction semantics are schema-separated from texture-placement variation, and duplicate declarations fail closed rather than applying the same signal twice
procedural paving binding validates every modeled-unit, joint, substrate and border target, semantic range and interpolation contract before atomically replacing output
native Blender 4.5.13 rejects unsupported texture semantics, duplicate variation declarations, unpaired fields, excessive amounts, missing attributes and out-of-range masks
the native semantic/control render pair changes only the edge-wear and dirt masks and measures a decoded-pixel mean absolute difference above the regression threshold

historic and contemporary assembled scenes both pass all eight structural/render gates and retain exact mass-conserving fields with errors of 4.829470157119431e-15 and 7.244205235679146e-15 cubic metres

the two hosts independently carry 180888 and 216616 paving vertices, 123320 and 147680 triangles, and the same five-attribute contract without duplicate per-material geometry; indexed top rings avoid duplicated coplanar vertices
blockingVisualDefects: neither assembled host reaches production photorealism and neither procedural paving material or environment is publishable from this evidence
historic paving remains too regular in silhouette, course rhythm and mineral response; the dirt band reads as restrained edge darkening rather than accumulated age, traffic and repair history
contemporary paving remains pale and chalky, with broad bright wet reflection and insufficient aggregate, staining, abrasion and drainage variation
both surfaces lack longer-range traffic paths, shelter/runoff history, local repairs, chipped silhouettes and coherent multi-scale colour/roughness evolution
facade shells, glazing, interiors and precipitation remain simplified production candidates and prevent the scene from reading as a photographic world
nextGenericDependencies: a renderer-independent surface-history field combining traffic, shelter, drainage, repair age and exposure at centimetre-to-metre scales
richer project-owned mineral/concrete response or semantically suitable homogeneous permissive sources with calibrated albedo, roughness, normal and displacement evidence
bounded chipped/broken unit silhouette families and course-level construction irregularity that preserve walkability and physical dimensions
layered facade construction materials, glazing/interior density and receiver-aware precipitation integration

queuedReusableWork.productionClothing: Remains queued behind the current higher-priority environment/material work, including panels/patterns, seams, hems, thickness, shoulder/armholes, reusable weights/correctives, folds/wrinkles, cloth materials, selective simulation and temporal verification.

notes: The benchmark was not rerendered. These unrelated hosts are reusable-system transfer fixtures. The targeted contract passes, while visual publication remains explicitly rejected.
